title.zh: Avalanche’s Helicon upgrade cuts validator lockups from 14 days to 48 hours

current_state.zh: Avalanche's Helicon upgrade, activating September 22, reduces the minimum validator commitment from 14 days to 48 hours, adds auto-renewal, and requires 90% uptime to earn rewards and renew.
